# What a law of the whole and no part takes / 整体而无部分之律所需

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-a-law-of-the-whole-and-no-part-takes` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](what-a-law-of-the-whole-and-no-part-takes.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> With numbered conditions, a counterexample to the least registration, like every law of the whole and no part, exists exactly where a rule decides of every Boolean sequence whether it is false throughout: WLPO as a rule. The decision of vanishing is exactly LPO as a rule.
>
> 条件编号时，最小的识的反例，如每个整体而无部分之律，恰在一个规则判定每个布尔序列是否处处为假之处存在：弱有限全知原则作为规则。消失之判定恰是有限全知原则作为规则。

## Laws / 规律

1. A number read off levels is changed by no condition where levels differing at one condition only give it alike; exactly then levels agreeing from some condition on give it alike, the conditions below changed one at a time: what no part changes, only the tail sets.<br>从水平读出的数，只在一个条件上不同的水平给出相同者，说没有一个条件改变它；这恰是从某个条件起相同的水平给出相同者，其下的条件一次换一个：没有部分改变的，只由尾所定。 (`Becoming.ChangedByNoCondition`, `Becoming.ChangedByNoCondition.eq_of_agree_from`, `Becoming.ChangedByNoCondition.of_agree_from`)
2. The law of a whole exchanges at every step a number read off the levels at step 0. Where no condition changes the number, it reads what has stood, is insensitive to every condition and reads through the conditions from any one on; where the number differs, it does not read through what it is sensitive to, nor finitely many conditions, and has no least registration. The tail law is that of the indicator of vanishing.<br>整体之律在每步与每个条件交换水平在第 0 步所读的数。这个数不被任何条件改变时，律读已立者，不敏感于每个条件，经从任一条件起的各条件而读；这个数有差别时，它不经其敏感而读，不读有限多个条件，没有最小的识。尾之律是消失之指示的整体之律。 (`Becoming.wholeLaw`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_reads_from`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_insensitive`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_not_sensitive`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_through_from`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_not_through_sensitive`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_not_readsFinitely`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_no_least_registration`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_changedByNoCondition`, `Becoming.tailLaw_eq_wholeLaw`)
3. Mixing two histories along a Boolean sequence ends by comparing two numbers, which is decided, so the mix gives a rule deciding, of every Boolean sequence, whether it is false throughout. A law insensitive at a step to every condition that still differs there, and every counterexample to the least registration, each give such a rule; the rule gives the weak limited principle of omniscience.<br>沿一个布尔序列混合两段历史，再比较两个数；比较是判定的，所以混合给出一个规则，对每个布尔序列判定它是否处处为假。在某步不敏感于每个条件而仍有差别的律，与最小的识的每个反例，各给出这样的规则；规则给出弱有限全知原则。 (`Becoming.mixedDecision`, `Becoming.insensitiveDiffersDecision`, `Becoming.notThroughSensitiveDecision`, `Becoming.WLPO.of_rule`)
4. Given such a rule, whether levels vanish from condition N on is decided, and whether they vanish from no condition on is decided by the rule again. This indicator is changed by no condition, tells levels all 0 from levels all 1, and sums to 1 with the indicator of vanishing where that is given; its law reads what has stood, is insensitive to every condition and still differs.<br>给定这样的规则，水平从第 N 个条件起是否消失可判定，水平是否从哪个条件起都不消失由规则再判定一次。这个指示不被任何条件改变，在全为 0 与全为 1 的水平之间不同，与消失之指示（给定时）之和为 1；它的律读已立者，不敏感于每个条件而仍有差别。 (`Becoming.Tail.nonzero`, `Becoming.Tail.eq_zero_of_nonzero_false`, `Becoming.Tail.levelsFrom`, `Becoming.Tail.false_of_not_true`, `Becoming.Tail.add_eq`, `Becoming.vanishesFrom`, `Becoming.vanishesFrom_true`, `Becoming.vanishesFrom_of`, `Becoming.vanishesFrom_never_iff`, `Becoming.neverIndicator`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_eq_one`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_eq_zero`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_eq_of_agree`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_changedByNoCondition`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_zeros`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_ones`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_add_vanishIndicator`, `Becoming.neverLaw`, `Becoming.neverLaw_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.neverLaw_insensitive`, `Becoming.neverLaw_not_sensitive`, `Becoming.neverLaw_differs`)
5. With the conditions numbered by the natural numbers, a number changed by no condition that still differs, a law insensitive at a step to every condition that still differs there, and a counterexample to the least registration each exist exactly where a rule decides, of every Boolean sequence, whether it is false throughout.<br>条件以自然数编号时，不被任何条件改变而仍有差别的数、在某步不敏感于每个条件而仍有差别的律、最小的识的反例，各恰在一个规则判定每个布尔序列是否处处为假之处存在。 (`Becoming.changedByNoCondition_iff_rule`, `Becoming.insensitive_differs_iff_rule`, `Becoming.not_through_sensitive_iff_rule`)
6. The decision of vanishing gives a rule deciding, of every Boolean sequence, whether it has a true; such a rule decides vanishing in two passes, whether some level from N on is above 0 for each N, then whether the answer is no for some N. So the two exist exactly together; the rule gives the weak rule and the limited principle of omniscience.<br>消失之判定给出一个规则，对每个布尔序列判定它是否有真者；这样的规则分两次判定消失：对每个 N 判定从 N 起是否有水平大于 0，再判定是否有某个 N 的回答为否。所以两者恰在同处存在；这个规则给出弱的规则与有限全知原则。 (`Becoming.Tail.false_of_not_eq_true`, `Becoming.Tail.not_eq_true_of_false`, `Becoming.lpoRuleOfVanishDecision`, `Becoming.raisedFrom`, `Becoming.raisedFrom_false`, `Becoming.raisedFrom_of`, `Becoming.vanishDecisionOfLPORule`, `Becoming.wlpoRuleOfLPORule`, `Becoming.LPO.of_rule`, `Becoming.vanishDecision_iff_lpoRule`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. A rule deciding, of every Boolean sequence, whether it is false throughout (or whether it has a true), and the decision of vanishing, are written in as hypotheses where used, never assumed; the theorems of omniscience number the conditions by the natural numbers.<br>不加公理。规则（对每个布尔序列判定它是否处处为假，或是否有真者）与消失之判定在用到处作为假设写入，不假定；全知的定理以自然数为条件编号。
- Equality of numbers is decided where histories are compared, and of conditions where they are mixed, as in Becoming.Sensitivity; no premise is added.<br>比较历史时数的相等是判定的，混合条件时条件的相等亦然，如 Becoming.Sensitivity；不另加前提。

## Does not show / 未表明

- That the proposition WLPO gives a rule: that step chooses a function from a relation, which the core does not assume; so the equivalences are stated for rules.<br>命题 WLPO 给出规则：那一步从关系选出函数，核心不假定；所以当且仅当以规则陈述。
- Whether the weak rule gives the limited principle's rule or the decision of vanishing, so whether the tail law takes strictly more than a counterexample needs; as propositions WLPO does not give LPO (Akama–Berardi–Hayashi–Kohlenbach 2004).<br>弱的规则是否给出有限全知原则的规则或消失之判定，所以尾之律是否严格多取；作为命题，弱有限全知原则推不出有限全知原则（Akama–Berardi–Hayashi–Kohlenbach 2004）。
- Given the rule, reading what has stood does not imply reading through what one is sensitive to.<br>给定规则时，读已立者不推出经其敏感而读。 Witness: `Becoming.wholeLaw_not_through_sensitive`.
- What a counterexample gives where the conditions are not numbered by the natural numbers; sensitivity read in temporal order; a measure of dependence.<br>条件不以自然数编号时反例给出什么；按时间先后读的敏感；依存的度量。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** The law of levels that never vanish (given the rule): it reads what has stood, is insensitive to every condition and still differs: a counterexample to the least registration built from the weak limited principle of omniscience as a rule alone.<br>永不消失之律（给定规则）：读已立者，不敏感于每个条件而仍有差别：只由弱有限全知原则作为规则造出的最小的识的反例。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Tail.lean)

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren, 12 October 2026, the goal: “move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”. This result answers the first item of the next_delta of sensitivity-is-the-least-registration: the exact strength of a counterexample's existence. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): what depends on the whole and on no part of it is given exactly where it can be decided, of every unending record of yes and no, whether it says no throughout; with the conditions numbered, the least registration fails exactly at this omniscience and needs no more of it, and the core does not assume it. Read as whether levels never vanish, a whole of this kind takes only the weak rule; read as whether they vanish eventually, a related whole, classically its complement but in the core another law, takes the rule of the limited principle. The mathematics is standard: the weak limited principle of omniscience of constructive reverse mathematics (Bridges and Richman 1987; the limited principle is Bishop's, 1967), stated here as a rule.<br>Ren 2026-10-12 的目标：“move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”。本结果回答 sensitivity-is-the-least-registration 的 next_delta 首项：反例之存在的确切强度。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：依存于整体而不依存于其任何部分者，恰在能对每个无尽的是非记录判定它是否全是否之处给出；条件编号时，最小的识恰在这一全知处不成立，不需要更多，核心不假定它。读作水平永不消失，这一类整体只需要弱的规则；读作终将消失，一个相关的整体（经典地是其补，在核心中是另一个律）需要有限全知原则的规则。数学是标准的：构造性反推数学中的弱有限全知原则（Bridges 与 Richman 1987；有限全知原则出自 Bishop 1967），这里以规则陈述。
